en.title: Harry Styles Releases ‘Coming Up Roses’ Music Video With Waltz Performance
en.dek: The video features Styles dancing with partners and a photo finish, released during his Madison Square Garden residency.
facts: Harry Styles released a music video for "Coming Up Roses" from his album "Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally".
The video was directed by Bradley & Pablo, who also directed "Watermelon Sugar" and "Late Night Talking".
Styles performs a waltz with partners, ending with a photo finish.
The video was announced during the 27th of 30 shows at Madison Square Garden on October 26.
The song is the fourth single from the album, and the album debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 430,000 equivalent album units.
body: According to Variety, Harry Styles released a music video for "Coming Up Roses" from his fourth album "Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally." The video was directed by Bradley & Pablo, who also directed "Watermelon Sugar" and "Late Night Talking."

Styles performs a waltz with various partners, then a woman does an interpretive dance, and the group ends with a photo finish, smiling for the camera. The video was announced during the 27th of 30 shows at Madison Square Garden on October 26, during the "Together, Together" residency.
The song is the fourth single from the album, according to Rolling Stone. The album debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 430,000 equivalent album units, according to Variety.
en.context: Harry Styles is touring with his "Together, Together" residency at Madison Square Garden and has been releasing singles from his fourth album. The new video was unveiled during this residency.
